jobs.description: Data Strategy / Business Analyst Consultant DETAILS Location : Remote Position Type : 6-week+ Contract Hourly / Salary : to $85W2+ (based on experience level) JOB SUMMARY Vaco is currently seeking a Data Strategy / Business Analysis Consultant for an enterprise Data and AI strategy engagement. The BA will facilitate stakeholder discovery, capture business requirements, and translate workshop discussions into structured deliverables supporting enterprise data governance and Data / AI product strategies. Partnering with Data Architects, Engagement Leadership, and business stakeholders, the BA will document current-state challenges, prioritize data and AI product opportunities, and help develop a data governance framework. The role operates at the intersection of Business Analysis, Data Governance, Data Architecture, Technical Writing, and AI Enablement, requiring strong workshop facilitation, real-time documentation, business-to-technical translation, and the ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly. Workshop Facilitation Support - Capturing requirements, use cases, decisions, and action items during stakeholder workshops while producing structured documentation in real time. Business Analysis / Requirements Elicitation - Conducting stakeholder interviews, documenting current-state processes, identifying pain points, and translating business needs into actionable requirements. Technical Documentation - Developing business and technical deliverables including workshop summaries, use case documentation, governance artifacts, and prioritized Data / AI product recommendations. Data Governance Support - Assisting with the development of ownership models, stewardship processes, metadata standards, and governance documentation supporting enterprise data initiatives. Data / AI Product Definition - Helping define reusable data products and AI use cases by documenting business capabilities, data requirements, and expected outcomes. Business / Technical Translation - Bridging communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure requirements, priorities, and deliverables are clearly understood and documented. jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: Job Description Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues. The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights. Enterprise Platforms is a company-wide center of excellence responsible for the product management and engineering of four critical platforms that underpin American Express’ essential customer segments, value propositions, and business lines: Enterprise Money Movement, U.S. Deposits, Global Accounts Receivable, and Global Loyalty & Benefits. Technology Business Management is American Express' Technology operations including investment management processes, strategy, vendor management, global workforce and talent strategy, and Transforming Ways of Working program. Let’s Build On What You Know. The Enterprise FinOps team is a key pillar within the Integrated Data, Engineering & Analytics organization. We are seeking a Data Engineer II to join our team and help deliver scalable data solutions that support public cloud financial management. This role will focus on building and maintaining data pipelines, supporting analytics and reporting capabilities, and improving data quality, automation, and access to insights that enable more effective financial and operational decision-making. Responsibilities Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines and workflows that support cloud financial management, reporting, and analytics use cases. Design and support data models, transformations, and datasets that enable accurate, timely, and scalable dashboarding and self-service reporting. Partner with Finance, Engineering, Product, and analytics stakeholders to translate business needs into effective data solutions. Develop and support dashboards, curated datasets, and recurring data products delivered to end users on a consistent cadence. Maintain and enhance data infrastructure that supports both internal analytics and customer-facing or self-service access patterns. Contribute to automation initiatives that improve data quality, operational efficiency, and the reliability of reporting processes. Apply best practices in data engineering, governance, and cloud cost data management to continuously improve platform capabilities. Support data integration and cost attribution solutions by working closely with engineers, analysts, and business partners across the organization. Qualifications Foundational knowledge of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and structured data management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with large datasets and support data-driven decision-making. Strong data modeling skills. Apptio Cloudability and Apptio TBM a plus Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Demonstrated knowledge of database management systems and related ecosystems Experience in SQL and Python (or other similar programming languages) Experience with Agile methodologies is desirable Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects with competing deadlines Ability to adapt to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on key objectives. Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions. About Us At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. jobs.description: Voxelmaps is seeking to hire a hybrid Developer & Data Process Engineer to support both our Research & Development and data processing operations teams. This is a full-time, permanent role with an immediate start date. This position blends full stack application development with data pipeline and cloud infrastructure work , focusing on building scalable web platforms while supporting the processing, transformation, and validation of large datasets generated from mapping systems. You must live in AUSTIN, TX or be willing to relocate, as this is an office-based role not remote . What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain modern .NET-based web applications and APIs Build and support data processing pipelines for large-scale mapping datasets Work with cloud infrastructure (AWS) to support application and data workflows Develop and maintain frontend components using modern JavaScript frameworks Execute, monitor, and troubleshoot data processing workflows Write and maintain automation scripts (Bash/Python) Manage and deploy services using containerized environments Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions Debug, test, and optimize both application code and data pipelines Ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability What We Expect Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Ability to work both independently and collaboratively Ownership mindset with consistent delivery of results Ability to manage a mix of development, infrastructure, and data tasks Strong communication skills and ability to follow structured workflows Required Experience > Application Development: Strong experience with C# and .NET / .NET Core / ASP.NET Core Experience building REST APIs and backend systems Frontend development experience with JavaScript / TypeScript and React Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design Strong SQL experience (SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL) > Systems, Cloud & Data: Strong experience with Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04) Experience working with AWS, specifically: EC2 (compute instances) S3 (storage and data handling) Experience using GitLab for version control and collaboration Strong experience writing Bash scripts for automation Experience using SSH for remote system access and management Experience working with Docker (containers, images, logs, volumes) Ability to troubleshoot data pipelines and system-level issues Nice to Have Experience with Keycloak (identity and access management) Familiarity with server monitoring and observability tools Experience with Ansible or infrastructure automation tools Experience with Python 3 (data processing, scripting, or automation) Experience with CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with microservices or distributed systems Exposure to data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) Experience with Redis, caching systems, or message brokers Preferred Background 3+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, or data engineering Experience delivering production-grade applications or data pipelines Experience working with large datasets or cloud-based systems Compensation $95,000 per year gross salary Job Details Job Type: Full Time Location: Austin, TX Work Model: On-site (office environment required) Benefits: Included Recruitment Process Application → Screening Interviews → Technical Evaluation → Final Interview → Decision → Hire → Probation Period Evaluation DO NOT CONTACT THE HIRING MANAGER DIRECTLY. YOU MUST FOLLOW THE APPLICATION PROCESS. About us: Voxelmaps Inc. was originally a spin-off from Navmii, one of the leading navigation and mapping companies in the world. Voxelmap’s mission is to build a true 4D volumetric model of the planet, combining visual, spatial and temporal data to create the most detailed map of the world. It does this using a unique patent-pending technology using MRVOGs (Multi-Resolution, Voxel Occupancy Grids). The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas, USA and works with some of the world’s largest companies across North America and Europe. jobs.title: Data Engineer (AWS, Azure, GCP)
jobs.description: CapTech is an award-winning consulting firm that collaborates with clients to achieve what’s possible through the power of technology. At CapTech, we’re passionate about the work we do and the results we achieve for our clients. From the outset, our founders shared a collective passion to create a consultancy centered on strong relationships that would stand the test of time. Today we work alongside clients that include Fortune 100 companies, mid-sized enterprises, and government agencies, a list that spans across the country. Job Description CapTech Data Engineering consultants enable clients to build and maintain advanced data systems that bring together data from disparate sources in order to enable decision-makers. We build pipelines and prepare data for use by data scientists, data analysts, and other data systems. We love solving problems and providing creative solutions for our clients. Cloud Data Engineers leverage the client’s cloud infrastructure to deliver this value today and to scale for the future. We enjoy a collaborative environment and have many opportunities to learn from and share knowledge with other developers, architects, and our clients. Specific responsibilities for the Data Engineer – Cloud position include: Developing data pipelines and other data products using Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Advising clients on specific technologies and methodologies for utilizing cloud resources to efficiently ingest and process data quickly Utilizing your skills in engineering best practices to solve complex data problems Collaborating with end users, development staff, and business analysts to ensure that prospective data architecture plans maximize the value of client data across the organization. Articulating architectural differences between solution methods and the advantages/disadvantages of each Qualifications Typical experience for successful candidates includes: Experience delivering solutions on a major cloud platform Ability to think strategically and relate architectural decisions/recommendations to business needs and client culture Experience in the design and implementation of data architecture solutions A wide range of production database experience, usually including substantial SQL expertise, database administration, and scripting data pipelines Ability to assess and utilize traditional and modern architectural components required based on business needs. A demonstrable ability to deliver production data pipelines and other data products. This could be hands on experience, degree, certification, bootcamp, or other learning. Skills: Successful candidates usually have demonstrable experience with technologies in some of these categories: Languages: SQL, Python, Java, R, C# / C++ / C Database: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Aurora, Presto, BigQuery, Oracle DevOps: git, docker, subversion, Kubernetes, Jenkins Additional Technologies: Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Kinesis, Hadoop, Lambda, EMR Popular Certifications: AWS Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals, Google Associate Cloud Engineer Additional Information We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. Job Description CapTech Machine Learning Engineers are responsible for designing and implementing data-driven solutions for our clients, with a specific focus on building and deploying scalable machine learning systems in enterprise environments. CapTech employees enjoy a collaborative environment and have many opportunities to learn from and share knowledge with other CapTech analysts, architects, and our clients. Analyzing and transforming large datasets hosted on a variety of enterprise-level data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). Designing, developing, and deploying advanced analytical solutions leveraging client data (e.g., recommender systems, natural language processing, risk scoring). Productionizing ML systems with a focus on optimization and scalability to satisfy clients’ requirements. Growing CapTech’s Machine Learning and Data Science practices through delivering client presentations, writing proposals, attending various business development events, and leading teams of junior data scientists and engineers. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Hands-on experience manipulating and analyzing large (multi-billion record) data sets. Hands-on experience developing data-driven solutions using Python, Scala, or similar languages. Proficiency leveraging SQL, Spark, NoSQL, and/or cloud data processing frameworks in a production setting. Proficiency with containerization (e.g., Docker) and microservices. Proficiency with data warehousing tools/environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure SQL, Amazon RDS Comfort and proficiency in framing data-driven problems from cross-industry business requirements. Knowledge of DevOps and automation best practices. Knowledge of statistics and statistical modeling methods. Knowledge of model management and model versioning best practices. Experience working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Mistral, etc.) in production setting Experience with prompt engineering, MCP and RAG, and agentic AI architectures Strong understanding of conversational UX and prompt evaluation metrics Experience with agentic frameworks in practice (langchain, n8n, pydantic, etc.) Experience with multi-agent orchestration Additional Information We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About EAB At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve. At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards . For more information, visit our Careers page. The Role In Brief Data Engineer Their primary responsibility is to develop and deploy data services, inclusive of BI tools, integrations, reports, amongst other data configuration procedures between client IT systems and EAB technology. In addition, they work collectively with other EAB project and product development staff to implement data pipelines, manage projects and relationships with partners, set and execute against project milestones, and perform at the highest standards of quality, client satisfaction, and engagement throughout the implementation lifecycle. This role may be based in Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C. This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Primary Responsibilities Conceptualize, develop and deploy data extraction procedures working collaboratively with partners Develop recommendations for internal leadership around preferred data integration methodologies Ensure barriers to timely completion of Data Integration Services projects are anticipated and overcome Work effectively with internal and external project managers to ensure timely delivery of implementation Encapsulate findings through new product integration exercises for the overall benefit of EAB data integration effort Build and foster strong relationships with all levels of technical and non-technical staff at client institutions Proactively identify, recognize, and act on opportunities for improvement in order to advance business goals. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 2+ years’ experience extracting data from a variety of platforms, performing data mapping, data transformation, and loading data to the target system Client facing experience implementing software solutions Fluency in SQL skills Experience managing multiple clients/projects/stakeholders simultaneously Demonstrated experience serving as a project owner including managing communication progress to stake holders, risk identification and mitigation and facilitating problem solving Proven ability to communicate ideas and obtain buy-in Valid US Driver’s License Willingness to travel up to 15% domestically Ideal Qualifications Basic working knowledge of cloud operations, especially in AWS Basic working knowledge of network engineering, especially SaaS and hybrid (SaaS/on-premise) architecture 1-3+ years in higher education admissions data operations 1+ years’ experience extracting and transforming data using Python pandas Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role. Our benefits currently include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible 20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each) 401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non-birthing parents Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits . Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows, resolving issues proactively Design, implement, and maintain critical data systems from ETL/ELT, Data Warehouse, BI Tools, and everything in between Maintain documentation for data architecture, processes, and standards Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to support data needs.
